regime_context: Only 5 of 17 themes pass the absolute-trend gate in Hong Kong, with a narrowing rotation and no single dominant narrative. The eligible leader is Tech Hardware (headline) but its low breadth (0.167) tempers durability, while High-Dividend Blue Chips and Conglomerates show full breadth and higher durability. Macro backdrop is AI/tech chatter but with a very high unscheduled-news share (0.86), which favours defensive themes tactically.
emerging_watch: Monitor Tech Hardware & Semis (eligible, headline) for loss of eligibility via the absolute-trend gate; if its durability bar falls below 0.40 and breadth stays below 0.25 within 10 trading days, that would suggest leadership fragility. Kill this watch if Tech Hardware remains eligible and breadth improves above 0.4.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips is the most durable eligible theme: top durability bar (0.73), pure trend tag, full breadth (1.0), and not crowded. The validated absolute-trend gate confirms trend persistence with historically lower drawdown risk in this market. In an environment of high macro surprise, the defensive, income-character of this theme aligns with the detector's risk-control signal—not as a return forecast, but as a lower-volatility stay. Momentum rank (7th) acts purely as a focus lens, not a call.
theses.dissent: Defensive high-dividend names may lag sharply in a risk-on rotation if AI/tech narratives trigger a broad equity rally; the theme's low momentum score suggests no relative leadership, and a defensive overweight could underperform if geopolitical or macro surprises turn distinctly positive.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips' absolute-trend gate eligibility flips to false at any close within the 20-day horizon, or its durability bar drops below 0.5.
